# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# CMake build for xSypher-Stream.
#
#   cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
#   cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
#   ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
#
# The build produces:
#   build/xsypher.bpf.o            eBPF CO-RE object (clang -target bpf)
#   build/xsypher.skel.h           libbpf skeleton generated by bpftool
#   build/xsypher-collector        C++20 userspace daemon
#
# Kernel BTF (include/vmlinux.h) is produced by scripts/gen_vmlinux.sh and is
# a generated artifact, never checked in.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(xsypher-stream VERSION 2.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Toolchain discovery                                                          #
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

find_program(BPFTOOL_EXECUTABLE NAMES bpftool)
find_program(CLANG_EXECUTABLE NAMES clang-18 clang-17 clang-16 clang-15 clang)
find_program(BASH_EXECUTABLE NAMES bash)

if(NOT BASH_EXECUTABLE)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "bash is required to run scripts/gen_vmlinux.sh")
endif()

# libbpf: prefer pkg-config, fall back to a plain library search.
find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
if(PkgConfig_FOUND)
  pkg_check_modules(LIBBPF QUIET libbpf)
endif()

if(NOT LIBBPF_FOUND)
  find_path(LIBBPF_INCLUDE_DIR bpf/libbpf.h)
  find_library(LIBBPF_LIBRARY NAMES bpf)
  if(NOT LIBBPF_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT LIBBPF_LIBRARY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
      "libbpf development files not found. Install libbpf-dev (Debian/Ubuntu) "
      "or libbpf-devel (Fedora).")
  endif()
  set(LIBBPF_INCLUDE_DIRS ${LIBBPF_INCLUDE_DIR})
  set(LIBBPF_LIBRARIES ${LIBBPF_LIBRARY})
endif()

find_library(ELF_LIBRARY NAMES elf REQUIRED)
find_library(ZLIB_LIBRARY NAMES z REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Architecture                                                               #
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|amd64|AMD64)$")
  set(XSYPHER_BPF_ARCH x86)
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(aarch64|arm64|ARM64)$")
  set(XSYPHER_BPF_ARCH arm64)
else()
  message(FATAL_ERROR "unsupported architecture: ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Generated sources                                                          #
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
set(VMLINUX_HEADER ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include/vmlinux.h)
set(BPF_OBJECT ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/xsypher.bpf.o)
set(BPF_SKELETON ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/xsypher.skel.h)

add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT ${VMLINUX_HEADER}
  COMMAND ${BASH_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/gen_vmlinux.sh ${VMLINUX_HEADER}
  DEPENDS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/gen_vmlinux.sh
  COMMENT "Generating include/vmlinux.h from kernel BTF"
  VERBATIM)

add_custom_target(vmlinux_header DEPENDS ${VMLINUX_HEADER})

if(CLANG_EXECUTABLE AND BPFTOOL_EXECUTABLE)
  add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${BPF_OBJECT}
    COMMAND ${CLANG_EXECUTABLE}
            -g -O2 -target bpf
            -D__TARGET_ARCH_${XSYPHER_BPF_ARCH}
            -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter
            -Wno-missing-declarations -Wno-comment
            ${LIBBPF_CFLAGS}
            -I${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include
            -I${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
            -c ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/bpf/xsypher.bpf.c
            -o ${BPF_OBJECT}
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/bpf/xsypher.bpf.c
            ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include/xsypher_abi.h
            ${VMLINUX_HEADER}
    COMMENT "Compiling eBPF CO-RE object (${XSYPHER_BPF_ARCH})"
    VERBATIM)

  add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${BPF_SKELETON}
    COMMAND ${BPFTOOL_EXECUTABLE} gen skeleton ${BPF_OBJECT} > ${BPF_SKELETON}
    DEPENDS ${BPF_OBJECT}
    COMMENT "Generating libbpf skeleton"
    VERBATIM)

  add_custom_target(xsypher_bpf DEPENDS ${BPF_SKELETON})
  set(HAVE_BPF_TOOLCHAIN TRUE)
else()
  message(WARNING
    "clang and/or bpftool not found: skipping the eBPF object. The collector "
    "target will be skipped as well. Install clang + linux-tools-$(uname -r) "
    "to build the full system.")
  set(HAVE_BPF_TOOLCHAIN FALSE)
  add_custom_target(xsypher_bpf
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "BPF toolchain unavailable; nothing to do")
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Collector                                                                  #
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
if(HAVE_BPF_TOOLCHAIN)
  add_executable(xsypher-collector
    src/collector/main.cpp
    src/collector/bpf_loader.cpp
    src/collector/cgroup_resolver.cpp
    src/collector/uds_server.cpp)

  add_dependencies(xsypher-collector xsypher_bpf)

  target_include_directories(xsypher-collector PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/collector
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
    ${LIBBPF_INCLUDE_DIRS})

  target_compile_options(xsypher-collector PRIVATE
    -O3 -g -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wno-unused-parameter)

  target_link_libraries(xsypher-collector PRIVATE
    ${LIBBPF_LIBRARIES} ${ELF_LIBRARY} ${ZLIB_LIBRARY} Threads::Threads)

  install(TARGETS xsypher-collector RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)

  add_custom_target(bpf ALL DEPENDS xsypher_bpf)
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Python engine + tests                                                      #
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
install(DIRECTORY src/engine DESTINATION lib/xsypher
        FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.py")
install(FILES config/rules.yaml DESTINATION etc/xsypher)

find_program(PYTHON3_EXECUTABLE NAMES python3)
if(PYTHON3_EXECUTABLE)
  enable_testing()

  add_test(NAME wire_protocol
    COMMAND ${PYTHON3_EXECUTABLE} -m pytest tests/test_wire_protocol.py -q
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR})

  add_test(NAME lineage_and_rules
    COMMAND ${PYTHON3_EXECUTABLE} -m pytest tests/test_lineage_and_rules.py -q
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR})

  add_test(NAME end_to_end_mcp_attack
    COMMAND ${PYTHON3_EXECUTABLE} tests/simulate_mcp_attack.py --events 2000
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR})

  set_tests_properties(wire_protocol lineage_and_rules end_to_end_mcp_attack
    PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "PYTHONPATH=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

  add_custom_target(check
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_CTEST_COMMAND} --output-on-failure
    DEPENDS xsypher-collector
    USES_TERMINAL)
endif()

message(STATUS "xSypher-Stream ${PROJECT_VERSION}")
message(STATUS "  BPF arch      : ${XSYPHER_BPF_ARCH}")
message(STATUS "  clang         : ${CLANG_EXECUTABLE}")
message(STATUS "  bpftool       : ${BPFTOOL_EXECUTABLE}")
message(STATUS "  libbpf        : ${LIBBPF_LIBRARIES}")
message(STATUS "  build type    : ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
